attributes.title: 2027 Chicago Dental Society Midwinter Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Chicago Dental Society holds its 2027 Midwinter Meeting February 25 to 27, 2027, at 2301 S. Indiana Avenue in Chicago, the McCormick Place West address. The meeting combines lectures, hands-on courses and a large exhibit hall, and CDS lists it under its Events & CE section with a "Claim CE" service for attendees.

Registration covers the exhibit hall and the right to sign up for CE courses, which are booked separately. CDS member dentists and students register free of charge. From November through January, ADA member dentists from outside CDS pay $179 and non-member dentists $879; hygienists, assistants, office staff and residents pay $79. In February and on site the rates rise to $199, $899 and $99.

Course-level CE hours are shown per course on the meeting's schedule, so no single total is listed here.
